original_source_reads.observed_version: 2025 approval; date confirmed against current FDA table

independence.NIDDK: Seven pages, one US-NIH authorship group. Physician/scientist-reviewed education, not seven independent confirmations.
independence.FDA: Three documents are one US-FDA regulatory authorship group. Current table verifies dates/status but is not independent of announcements.
independence.EASL_EASD_EASO: One jointly authored 2024 guideline; three societies are not three sources.
independence.shared_upstream: NIDDK pages cite AASLD2018 and older primary literature. EASL draws from overlapping MASLD literature; separately written guidelines do not imply independent trials. Resmetirom FDA and EASL describe the same pivotal development program. No claim is marked independent empirical replication.
independence.clinical_certification: Institutional expertise and publication review do not constitute this site receiving licensed clinical signoff.

source_conflicts.finding: 2021 NIDDK Medicines section still says no approved NAFLD/NASH medicines. Later US approvals supersede that sentence. Current draft correctly avoids repeating it.
source_conflicts.handling: Old page usable only for explicitly scoped still-supported lifestyle/herbal statements; do not bulk mark its full contents current.

source_conflicts.finding: 2024 guideline predates 2025 US indication; its then-current GLP-1 targeted-MASH approval/efficacy statements cannot be applied unchanged to September 2026.
source_conflicts.handling: Separate guideline date, treatment evidence and jurisdiction-specific regulatory decision.

bilingual_review.checked: Full 14-section Chinese/English text and 51 paired claims. No added numeric dose thresholds. US 2025 approval year agrees with current FDA table.
bilingual_review.details: FIB-4 input English error; English omits magnitude/durability condition in weight-loss paragraph; Chinese fibrosis adjective less precise than advanced.

mece_review.finding: MASLD parent content and mention of MASH/cirrhosis cannot count all ICD leaves. 脂肪肝 is a broad retrieval term rather than a diagnostic synonym; other fat-accumulation causes and alcohol categories must remain distinct.
mece_review.scope_gap: China and UK drug approval/pathway equivalence has not been verified; US-only statements remain explicitly US.

findings.issue: FIB-4英文计算输入错误，中文句式也容易混淆体型测量和评分。
findings.resolution: 明确评分使用年龄和AST/ALT/血小板，体重腰围另作代谢评估；两语等价，补第二独立来源。

findings.issue: 药物章没有解释具体药物作用和关键风险；FDA多页不构成独立交叉核验。
findings.resolution: 按药物分开适用范围、作用、不能解决的问题和主要风险；resmetirom可核对FDA肝损伤/胆囊问题及药物相互作用，Wegovy核对FDA禁忌及不良反应后找第二独立医学材料。风险不只改成查说明书。

findings.issue: 关键就医行动不是所有子句都有两源，且NHS急救框特指已经确诊肝硬化，正文扩大人群。
findings.resolution: 保留具体危险行动；以适用更广人群的权威急症资料补足，或明确分开已确诊肝硬化和未确诊症状路径。

findings.issue: 中英条件不完全相同：英文漏持续/较大减重幅度；明显纤维化未准确对应advanced。
findings.resolution: 统一幅度/持续条件，纤维化程度用可理解且与指南一致的表述；不加入未经双源核对的数值。

findings.issue: 检查局限/治疗的当前精确定位有缺口，或来源分别支持不同子句。
findings.resolution: 按逐条结果修正实际页码、拆原子主张、补第二源；不以网页提到术语视为已支持整句。

findings.issue: 当前仅一独立编写组；多个NIH页面、FDA公告/表格或三学会联合指南均不能累加。
findings.resolution: 关键行动、阈值、风险与疗效补第二独立编写材料。解释可保留真实单源状态，但依本轮要求不标双源通过。

findings.issue: 复合主张、证据边界或人群适用范围未完整交叉支持；部分实际行动登记成explanation。
findings.resolution: 按每条assessment拆分/补定位，记录不能解决的缺口；保留合理否定句与风险边界，不机械删文制造通过。

findings.issue: 来源时间/地区边界必须显式保留：旧NAFLD不等同全部MASLD条件，2021治疗页仍写没有获批药物，2024欧洲指南先于2025美国Wegovy适应证。
findings.resolution: 仅使用旧页仍适用的具体段落；药物批准明确美国与截至日期，补其他地区资料才可登记相关地区已核验，不把美国规则推广全球。

next_step: Author fixes listed content/binding gaps, then targeted review of changed claims; retain source independence and true clinical status.
